items.title_zh: Narayana Murthy 和女儿 Akshata 在班加罗尔享用“Corner House”冰淇淋
items.title_en: Narayana Murthy and daughter Akshata enjoy 'Corner House' ice cream in Bengaluru
items.summary_zh: Infosys 创始人 Narayana Murthy 和他的女儿 Akshata Murty 在班加罗尔一家受欢迎的店里一起享用冰淇淋的照片在社交媒体上引起了关注。该图像展示了 Murthy 家族的简单和脚踏实地的本质。
items.summary_en: A viral picture of Infosys founder Narayana Murthy and his daughter, Akshata Murty, enjoying ice cream together at a popular parlour in Bengaluru has gained attention on social media. The image showcases the simplicity and down-to-earth nature of the Murthy family.

items.title_zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特在超级碗上为男友特拉维斯·凯尔斯欢呼
items.title_en: Taylor Swift cheers boyfriend Travis Kelce at the Super Bowl
items.summary_zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 在第十八届超级碗 (Super Bowl LVIII) 上时尚亮相，她穿着一身别致的黑色套装，一件红色夹克随意地披在肩上。她的时尚选择与酋长队成员的着装一致，并与她专辑“Midnights”中的热门歌曲“Anti-Hero”巧妙地联系在一起。
items.summary_en: Taylor Swift made a stylish appearance at Super Bowl LVIII, wearing a chic ensemble with a black outfit and a red jacket casually draped over one shoulder. Her fashion choice was in line with the attire of Chiefs members and subtly connected to her hit song 'Anti-Hero' from the album 'Midnights.'
